nodes.label: M6.2 - Post-booking redirect, richer emails, overlay, self-booking block
M6.3 - Claude-Design fidelity pass + status lifecycle + analytics
AuthController (register / login / me)
nodes.rationale: RegisterRequest has no role field at all, so a body-crafted role can never escalate a self-registration (FR-16).

nodes.label: AvailabilityManagementService (bulk generate/preview/delete)
nodes.rationale: Generation stays non-destructive: existing and booked slots are skipped, never overwritten - a flagged deviation from the design's 'replace' copy, and it makes re-running the generator idempotent.

nodes.label: ServiceController (public reads + admin CRUD + provider assignment)
GoogleCalendarService.createMeetingEvent
nodes.rationale: Never throws - a Meet-generation failure degrades to a booking without a link rather than failing the booking (NFR-4).

nodes.label: EmailService (consumer confirmation + provider notification)
nodes.rationale: Logs and swallows failures so a mail problem can never break an otherwise successful booking (NFR-4).

nodes.label: BookingStatus enum {CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, NO_SHOW, VACANT}
LoadingOverlay (full-page blur during booking round-trip)
nodes.rationale: Covers the real latency of the synchronous Google Calendar + email round-trip so a slow booking does not read as broken.

nodes.label: CalendarDayCell (DS component, extended with total prop)
nodes.rationale: Extended with an optional `total` prop - a deliberate backward-compatible design-system extension rather than a fork of the component.

nodes.label: Accordion (DS component, provider slot lists + FAQ)
/appointments (consumer-only My Appointments)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately consumer-only after user pushback: providers/admins see their own consumer-side bookings via the '(You)' merge into /dashboard instead of a second page.

nodes.label: Demo seed migrations V3-V6 (services, providers/slots, admin, fallback links)
nodes.rationale: Demo data only, per the bootcamp rule; the admin seed was a bootstrapping requirement since only an admin can create or promote users and none existed yet.

nodes.label: Feature-based backend packaging (entity->repo->service->controller)
nodes.rationale: Packages by feature under com.ammar.bookingsystem with DTOs at the boundary and manual mapping - no MapStruct for the MVP.

nodes.label: Stateless JWT Bearer auth decision
nodes.rationale: Stateless session policy with the token in the Authorization header rather than a cookie, which is also why CORS needs no credentials support.

nodes.label: Gotcha: Spring Boot 4 needs spring-boot-starter-flyway
nodes.rationale: Boot 4 moved FlywayAutoConfiguration into its own module, so bare flyway-core never triggers it - Flyway silently never ran and the DB stayed empty with zero errors until ddl-auto: validate surfaced missing tables.

nodes.label: Gotcha: Jackson 3 relocation (tools.jackson.*)
nodes.rationale: com.fasterxml.jackson ObjectMapper compiles but throws NoClassDefFoundError at runtime on this stack; fixed by not depending on Jackson at all in the hand-rolled 401/403 JSON writer.

nodes.label: Gotcha: jjwt 0.13 API drift (parserBuilder no longer exists)
nodes.rationale: Even context7's own snippet showed the removed Jwts.parserBuilder(); corrected to Jwts.parser()...parseSignedClaims().

nodes.label: Bug: permitAll(/api/auth/**) also exposed /api/auth/me
nodes.rationale: Anonymous requests reached the controller and surfaced as an opaque 500 instead of a clean 401; fixed by naming /register and /login explicitly, and by adding logging to the blanket Exception handler so this class of bug cannot hide silently.

nodes.label: Bug: @PreAuthorize denials returned 500 instead of 403
nodes.rationale: Method-security AccessDeniedException is thrown inside the MVC handler invocation, so it never reaches SecurityConfig's filter-level accessDeniedHandler; needs its own @ExceptionHandler.

nodes.label: Bug: stale inverse @ManyToMany collection from first-level cache
nodes.rationale: Re-fetching the inverse side in the same persistence context returns the already-loaded instance with a stale lazy collection; fixed by building the response from the known new set instead of re-querying.

nodes.label: Bug: native number/date/time inputs render OS-locale digits
nodes.rationale: Chromium showed Arabic-Indic digits and Arabic month labels on an Arabic OS locale; converted to type=text with format placeholders and regex validation because this project has explicit RTL/Arabic i18n plans.

nodes.label: Bug: void @DeleteMapping returns 200 + empty body, not 204
nodes.rationale: The frontend api() helper only special-cased 204 before res.json(), so a successful delete surfaced as a UI error; fixed on both ends - explicit noContent() and a text check before parsing regardless of status.

nodes.label: Bug: DS Accordion used hooks without "use client"
nodes.rationale: Threw 'useState is not a function' at build time when rendered from the landing page's Server Component tree; fixed at the component itself since it is inherently interactive.

nodes.label: Bug: OAuth callback required code/state params
nodes.rationale: Google's most common non-happy-path - the provider clicking Cancel - redirects with error=access_denied and no code param at all, which threw an uncaught MissingServletRequestParameterException as a raw 500 page.

nodes.label: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE slot lock in booking transaction
nodes.rationale: Locks the slot row before validating AVAILABLE + horizon + provider-offers-service, so two concurrent bookings of the same slot cannot both succeed (second gets 409).

nodes.label: Signed 10-minute OAuth state JWT
nodes.rationale: Google's callback is a plain browser redirect carrying no Authorization header, so the initiating provider's id must travel in a short-lived purpose-tagged signed token.

nodes.label: Provider cannot book their own availability
nodes.rationale: Blocked server-side in BookingService before touching the DB (400) as well as filtered client-side, because the client filter alone is not trusted; providers may still book OTHER providers' services as consumers.

nodes.label: VACANT is a synthesized, never-persisted status
nodes.rationale: A dashboard-only label for open slots with a negative synthetic id; the V7 DB CHECK constraint deliberately excludes it so it can never be written even though it is a Java enum value.

nodes.label: '(You)' merge of own consumer-side bookings into /dashboard
nodes.rationale: Mixing a provider's own bookings-as-consumer into their dashboard is what makes a '(You)' marker meaningful - on /appointments every row is already self, so it would be redundant there.

nodes.label: Testing strategy (slice tests + curl + chrome-devtools walkthroughs)
nodes.rationale: A few focused @SpringBootTest/slice tests for the security guard, booking transaction and window validation; everything else verified manually via REST client and browser walkthroughs.

nodes.label: Manual step U4: Google Cloud project, Calendar API, OAuth client
